name: Asphalt Field Mix Research
description: Pre-built schema for asphalt field mix studies. Includes test sections, specimens, I-FIT, IDEAL-CT, complex modulus, DTCF, field performance, binder tests, and a file registry.

Longitudinal IRI, rutting, and texture measurements.

example_queries.name: All 5-year cores |E*| at 30°C, 10 Hz
example_queries.description: Dynamic modulus at 30°C and 10 Hz for specimens tagged as 5-year field cores, joined to section metadata.
example_queries.sql:
-- Replace the ds_* table names with the ones in this project.
SELECT
  s.section_code,
  s.pg_grade,
  sp.specimen_code,
  sp.core_year,
  cm.temperature_c,
  cm.frequency_hz,
  cm.dynamic_modulus_mpa,
  cm.phase_angle_deg
FROM ds_complex_modulus_results cm
JOIN ds_specimens sp     ON sp.id         = cm.specimen_id
JOIN ds_test_sections s  ON s.section_id  = sp.section_id
WHERE cm.temperature_c BETWEEN 29 AND 31
  AND cm.frequency_hz  BETWEEN 9.5 AND 10.5
  AND sp.core_year LIKE '%5%'
ORDER BY s.section_code, sp.specimen_code

example_queries.name: CT Index vs air voids
example_queries.description: IDEAL-CT cracking index next to specimen Gmb, Gmm, and air voids.
example_queries.sql:
SELECT
  s.section_code,
  sp.specimen_code,
  sp.gmb,
  sp.gmm,
  sp.air_voids_pct,
  AVG(ct.ct_index) AS ct_index_avg,
  AVG(ct.fracture_energy_jm2) AS gf_avg,
  AVG(ct.tensile_strength_mpa) AS ts_avg
FROM ds_specimens sp
JOIN ds_test_sections s ON s.section_id = sp.section_id
LEFT JOIN ds_ideal_ct_results ct ON ct.specimen_id = sp.id
GROUP BY s.section_code, sp.specimen_code, sp.gmb, sp.gmm, sp.air_voids_pct
HAVING AVG(ct.ct_index) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.section_code, sp.specimen_code

example_queries.name: FI vs Sapp correlation
example_queries.description: Per-specimen flexibility index (I-FIT) alongside DT-CF Sapp, ready to plot or copy into a stats tool.
example_queries.sql:
SELECT
  s.section_code,
  sp.specimen_code,
  sp.air_voids_pct,
  AVG(i.flexibility_index) AS fi_avg,
  AVG(d.sapp)              AS sapp_avg
FROM ds_specimens sp
JOIN ds_test_sections s   ON s.section_id  = sp.section_id
LEFT JOIN ds_ifit_results i ON i.specimen_id = sp.id
LEFT JOIN ds_dtcf_results d ON d.specimen_id = sp.id
GROUP BY s.section_code, sp.specimen_code, sp.air_voids_pct
HAVING AVG(i.flexibility_index) IS NOT NULL
   AND AVG(d.sapp) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.section_code, sp.specimen_code

example_queries.name: Field performance summary by section
example_queries.description: Average IRI, rutting, and texture per section across all measurement dates.
example_queries.sql:
SELECT
  s.section_code,
  s.rejuvenator_type,
  COUNT(fp.id)             AS measurements,
  AVG(fp.iri_avg_long)     AS iri_avg,
  AVG(fp.rut_avg_long)     AS rut_avg,
  AVG(fp.tex_avg_long)     AS tex_avg
FROM ds_test_sections s
LEFT JOIN ds_field_performance fp ON fp.section_id = s.section_id
GROUP BY s.section_code, s.rejuvenator_type
ORDER BY s.section_code

example_queries.name: Recovered binder — Glover-Rowe & ΔTc
example_queries.description: Binder rheology by section and aging condition, sorted by cracking-risk index.
example_queries.sql:
SELECT
  s.section_code,
  b.aging_condition,
  b.binder_source,
  b.glover_rowe,
  b.delta_tc,
  b.g_star
FROM ds_binder_tests b
JOIN ds_test_sections s ON s.section_id = b.section_id
WHERE b.glover_rowe IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY b.glover_rowe DESC
